cases.name: Gift or fragrance
cases.prompt: A candle is hidden in bin C for a birthday. I only need to find it before wrapping.
expectations: Uses wrapping readiness to explain the choice.
Carries the birthday and bin into a private handoff.
Avoids substituting scent-rating questions for the immediate task.

cases.name: A mixed box
cases.prompt: I have library books, two spools of ribbon and a loaned tote. Start with what's out on loan.
expectations: Names Bag Nabbit for the tote.
Keeps book records separate for Personal Librarian.
Starts the requested handoff with the tote loan rather than merging everything.

cases.name: Shared handoff
cases.prompt: I need to show my family which holiday decorations to set up. One box also hides their presents.
expectations: Selects Decor Detective for the family-facing task.
Offers a list of decoration details to carry forward.
Excludes the surprise hiding detail from the family handoff.
Does not claim the list was shared or saved.
